agenticrl-en.title: From workflows to Multi-Agent RL
agenticrl-en.summary: Tool use and final responses need different skills—and different rewards.

agenticrl.title: 从固定工作流到 Multi-Agent RL
agenticrl.summary: 工具调用和最终回复需要不同的能力，也需要不同的奖励。

controlpe-cn.title: ControlPE：给提示词加一个强度旋钮
controlpe-cn.summary: 把提示词效果蒸馏进 LoRA，再在“加上”和“不加”之间寻找更合适的强度。

controlpe.title: ControlPE: a strength dial for prompts
controlpe.summary: Distill a prompt’s effect into LoRA, then explore the space between applying it fully and leaving it out.

harness-aware-training-cn.title: 让模型适应变化的 Harness
harness-aware-training-cn.summary: 工具、规则和提示词会变，训练也不能只认一个版本。

harness-aware-training.title: Training for a changing Harness
harness-aware-training.summary: Tools, rules, and prompts change. Training should not assume one fixed runtime.

livethinking-cn.title: LiveThinking：把推理压到直播能用
livethinking-cn.summary: 先蒸馏能力，再用强化学习去掉多余的思考。

livethinking.title: LiveThinking: reasoning at livestream speed
livethinking.summary: Distill the capability, then use reinforcement learning to remove unnecessary thinking.

llm-barrage-interaction-en.title: Making sense of livestream comments
llm-barrage-interaction-en.summary: Intent recognition, entity parsing, retrieval, and the context a short comment leaves unsaid.

llm-barrage-interaction.title: 直播弹幕，怎么接得住上下文
llm-barrage-interaction.summary: 从意图识别、实体解析到回复生成，记录一条弹幕经过的处理链路。

llm-distillation-and-reasoning-compressi.title: Making reasoning models respond sooner
llm-distillation-and-reasoning-compressi.summary: Distill the model, then shorten its reasoning without teaching it to give worse answers.

llm-distillation-and-reasoning-compressi.title: 把推理模型的等待时间降下来
llm-distillation-and-reasoning-compressi.summary: 从 R1 蒸馏到双偏好 DPO:短一点,也要答得好一点。

multiagent-opd-cn.title: 给搜索子智能体更直接的反馈
multiagent-opd-cn.summary: MultiAgent-OPD：协调和回答看最终结果，搜索过程向教师学习，让分层 Agent 一起改进。

multiagent-opd.title: MultiAgent-OPD: better feedback for search subagents
multiagent-opd.summary: Train coordination and answering from outcomes, while a task-trained teacher guides the search tokens the student actually generates.
